catalysts.quote: Announce topline Phase 3 data for subcutaneous BRIUMVI year-end 2026/first quarter 2027

catalysts.quote: Present preliminary Phase 1 azer-cel data in Progressive MS in the second half of 2026
catalysts.note: First (preliminary Phase 1) data with no named meeting, so typed as a readout rather than a conference presentation.

catalysts.quote: AEON plans to submit an IND for CMAP pharmacodynamic study in the fourth quarter of 2026
catalysts.note: The IND covers the CMAP pharmacodynamic study of ABP-450; also stated as "Q4 2026" and "later this year".

catalysts.quote: Enrollment for Part A has completed, with SPY001 and SPY002 Part A topline induction data announced in Q2 2026, and topline data expected for SPY003 in September 2026.

RA sub-study: Double-blind, placebo-controlled safety and efficacy study of two dose levels of SPY072 at Week 12 with open-label follow-up through Week 36. Topline proof-of-concept data are expected in September 2026.
catalysts.note: Same event as the CEO's "expected next month" for SPY072 in RA.

catalysts.quote: PsA sub-study: Double-blind, placebo-controlled safety and efficacy study of a single dose level of SPY072 at Week 16 with open-label follow-up through Week 40. Topline proof-of-concept data are expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.

axSpA sub-study: Double-blind, placebo-controlled safety and efficacy study of a single dose level of SPY072 at Week 16 with open-label follow-up through Week 40. Topline proof-of-concept data are expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.

Part B: Randomized and placebo-controlled assessment of the safety and efficacy of monotherapies and combinations, designed to provide dose-ranging data on monotherapies, proof-of-concept, and contribution of components for combinations, with induction data expected in 2027.
catalysts.note: First (induction) data from SKYLINE Part B, which tests several monotherapies and combinations, so no single drug is named.

catalysts.quote: Participated in pre-NDA meeting with U.S. FDA for volixibat in cholestatic pruritus due to PSC; planning additional discussions with the FDA before potential NDA submission, now targeted in H1 2027.
catalysts.note: Submission is described as "potential" and also stated as "first half of 2027".

catalysts.quote: Brelovitug AZURE-1 and AZURE-4 Phase 3 studies in chronic hepatitis delta virus (HDV) topline results expected in Q3 and Q4 2026, respectively.
catalysts.note: AZURE-1 readout; the sentence pairs "Q3" with AZURE-1 and the year 2026 is shared with Q4.

catalysts.quote: Brelovitug AZURE-1 and AZURE-4 Phase 3 studies in chronic hepatitis delta virus (HDV) topline results expected in Q3 and Q4 2026, respectively.

catalysts.quote: LIVMARLI EXPAND Phase 3 study in cholestatic pruritus due to additional rare cholestatic conditions topline results expected in Q4 2026.
catalysts.note: A readout for an approved drug in new conditions, typed as a readout rather than a label expansion.

catalysts.quote: Completed enrollment in the volixibat VANTAGE Phase 2b study in cholestatic pruritus due to primary biliary cholangitis (PBC); topline results expected in Q1 2027.
catalysts.note: Interim VANTAGE results were reported in 2024; this is the topline readout.

catalysts.quote: The FDA has accepted the NDA for zilurgisertib in FOP under Priority Review with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) date of September 26, 2026.

Acadia plans to present detailed safety and efficacy results from the RADIANT Phase 2 study in an oral presentation at the upcoming Clinical Trials on Alzheimer’s Disease (CTAD) conference, taking place November 16-19, 2026 in Boston.
